name: Omsk
uniques: [+15]% Strength for military units fighting in friendly territory
startIntroPart1: The Black League has endured the fires of the Russian collapse. Under Dmitry Yazov, Omsk prepares for the coming Great Trial.
startIntroPart2: The Germanic Reich destroyed your homeland, and the Black League has sworn that Russia will never forget. Rebuild your industry, strengthen your armies, and prepare for the struggle ahead. The Great Trial awaits.

name: Eurasianist State
startIntroPart1: Lev Nikolayevich Gumilyov, the peoples of Eurasia await their unification.
startIntroPart2: The old world has fallen. The Germans and their allies have divided the lands of the Eurasian peoples. But history has not ended. Through passionarity, a new civilization shall rise, uniting the steppe and forest under one banner. Build the Eurasian superstate!
declaringWar: Your people stand against the destiny of Eurasia. They shall be swept aside.
defeated: The passionarity of our people... has not yet vanished...

name: Ordosocialist Russia
startIntroPart1: Comrade Ivan Alexandrovich Serov, the revolution requires a new direction.
startIntroPart2: The old Soviet Union failed because it lacked the discipline and national unity necessary to survive. The workers require order, the nation requires strength, and the state requires absolute dedication. Build a new Russia under the banner of Ordosocialism!
declaringWar: The interests of the Russian nation and the socialist revolution demand your destruction.
defeated: The enemies of the Russian people have temporarily triumphed. The struggle continues.

name: Holy Russian Empire
uniqueName: The Regency of the True Emperor
startIntroPart1: Your Excellency, Blessed Regent Sergey Vladimirovich Taboritsky, the time has come.
startIntroPart2: The Tsarevich Alexei lives. His rightful throne awaits him, and you have been entrusted with the sacred duty of restoring the Russian Empire until his return. The enemies of the dynasty shall be eliminated, the Orthodox faith shall be restored, and the Russian people shall once again kneel before their rightful sovereign. Long live the Tsarevich!
declaringWar: You have committed an unforgivable offense against the rightful order. By the authority of the Regent, your destruction is decreed.
defeated: No... His Imperial Highness... Alexei... must return...

name: Aryan Brotherhood
startIntroPart1: Gutrum Vagner, Führer of the Aryan Brotherhood, the time has come to establish your Reich.
startIntroPart2: The German Reich has shown the world the power of its ideology. You believe Russia can be transformed into a new Aryan civilization. Your Brotherhood is weak, your industry is ruined, and your neighbors despise you. Prove your ideology through conquest.
declaringWar: The enemies of the Aryan rebirth shall be crushed!
defeated: There remains some justice in the Russian Anarchy.

name: Hyperborea
uniques: [+15]% Strength for military units fighting in friendly territory
startIntroPart1: Velimir, High Priest of Hyperborea and All Rus, your revelation has arrived.
startIntroPart2: Vagner's imitation of the Germans has failed. The true Aryans were never German. They were the ancient Slavs, inheritors of Hyperborea! Rebuild the civilization of your ancestors, unite the Russian lands and establish the eternal Slavic order.
declaringWar: The false peoples of this world shall bow before Hyperborea!
defeated: Hyperborea may fall, but its ancient legacy shall never be forgotten.

name: Tomsk
uniques: [+15]% Strength for military units fighting in friendly territory
startIntroPart1: Boris Leonidovich Pasternak, President of the Central Siberian Republic, the future of Russia rests upon your shoulders.
startIntroPart2: From the ashes of the old world, a republic has emerged. Artists, scientists, philosophers and statesmen have gathered in Tomsk to build something that Russia has not seen in decades: a nation founded upon constitutional government, intellectual freedom and the pursuit of knowledge. Your time is limited, President. Preserve the Republic and secure its future.
declaringWar: We have exhausted every avenue of diplomacy. The Republic shall defend itself.
defeated: Perhaps... the Republic of Letters was too ambitious a dream...

name: Novosibirsk
startIntroPart1: President Vasily Makarovich Shukshin, the people of Siberia have entrusted you with their future.
startIntroPart2: The Federation has survived war, corruption and the ambitions of military strongmen. Now the corporations threaten to become masters of the very country they helped build. You have promised the people democracy, federalism and a better future. Rebuild the economy, defend the Republic and prove that a free Siberia can stand among the great nations of the world.
declaringWar: We have no desire for war, but the sovereignty of the Federation must be defended!
defeated: We wanted to build something better. I only hope that our dream survives us.

name: West Siberian People's Republic
uniques: [+15]% Strength for military units fighting in friendly territory
startIntroPart1: Comrade Joseph Vissarionovich Stalin, the Soviet Union has fallen, but the Revolution lives on in Western Siberia.
startIntroPart2: The traitors of Bukharin have brought ruin upon the Soviet Union, and the German fascists have torn apart the motherland. But the Soviet people have not surrendered. From Tyumen, you shall rebuild the socialist state, industrialize the Siberian wilderness, restore the Red Army and reclaim every inch of Soviet territory. The Five-Year Plan must succeed!
declaringWar: The enemies of socialism have left us no choice. The Red Army shall advance!
defeated: The Soviet Union... the Revolution... I have failed them.

name: Tsardom of Vyatka
uniques: [+15]% Strength for military units fighting in friendly territory
startIntroPart1: Your Imperial Majesty, Vladimir III Romanov, rightful heir to the throne of All Russia.
startIntroPart2: For decades, Russia has suffered under revolution, civil war and foreign domination. Yet the House of Romanov has endured. From Vyatka, you shall restore the Russian Empire, reunite the divided lands and bring the imperial eagle back to its rightful place. May God protect the Tsar and all Russia!
declaringWar: You have challenged the authority of the Russian Crown. The Imperial Army shall answer!
defeated: The Romanov dynasty has endured exile, revolution and war. It shall endure this as well.
